ORICO TCM2-C3 NVMe M.2 SSD 10Gbps Transparent Aluminum Enclosure

The ORICO TCM2-C3 NVMe M.2 SSD Enclosure is a high-performance solution designed to transform your M.2 NVMe SSD into a portable external storage device. With a sleek and modern design, this enclosure combines transparent polycarbonate and aluminum alloy, offering both durability and an aesthetic appeal that showcases your SSD while ensuring effective heat dissipation. Equipped with a USB 3.1 Type-C output interface, the TCM2-C3 supports lightning-fast data transfer speeds of up to 10Gbps, thanks to its advanced JMS583 chip. This high-speed capability makes it ideal for transferring large files, such as high-definition videos, software applications, and backups, with minimal wait time. Supporting capacities of up to 2TB, this enclosure is perfect for users needing significant storage space for their projects or media collections. The ORICO TCM2-C3 is designed for versatility, as it is compatible with multiple operating systems, including Windows, macOS, and Linux, ensuring seamless connectivity across various devices. Its compact dimensions—measuring 108mm in length, 34mm in width, and 11.5mm in height—make it highly portable, allowing you to carry your data wherever you go. Available in a variety of stylish colors, including blue, red, silver, and black, this enclosure not only meets functional requirements but also caters to individual style preferences. The tool-free design simplifies installation, allowing users to easily slide in their M.2 NVMe SSD without the need for additional tools. The ORICO TCM2-C3 NVMe M.2 SSD Enclosure combines high-speed performance, stylish design, and broad compatibility, making it an excellent choice for anyone looking to enhance their storage capabilities on the go.

Features of the ORICO TCM2-C3 Transparent Aluminum Enclosure

  • High-Speed Data Transfer: Utilizes a USB 3.1 Type-C output interface with a JMS583 chip, enabling transfer speeds of up to 10Gbps, ideal for quickly moving large files.
  • Compatibility: Supports M.2 NVMe SSDs with a maximum capacity of 2TB, accommodating a wide range of storage needs.
  • Versatile OS Support: Compatible with multiple operating systems, including Windows, macOS, and Linux, ensuring seamless integration with various devices.
  • Stylish Design: Features a transparent polycarbonate casing combined with an aluminum alloy plate, offering a modern aesthetic that showcases the SSD.
  • Efficient Cooling: The aluminum alloy helps dissipate heat effectively, maintaining optimal performance during heavy usage.
  • Compact and Portable: With dimensions of 108mm (L) x 34mm (W) x 11.5mm (H), the enclosure is lightweight and easy to carry, making it perfect for on-the-go use.
  • Multiple Color Options: Available in blue, red, silver, and black, allowing users to choose an enclosure that suits their style.
  • Tool-Free Installation: Designed for easy assembly, allowing users to install their M.2 NVMe SSD without needing any additional tools.
  • Durable Construction: Made with high-quality materials that provide protection against physical damage while maintaining a sleek look.
